mentions.name: Three Chapters of Sci-Fi
mentions.description: A newsletter publishing short science fiction stories inspired by current news stories of the day, with each story deliberately limited to three chapters. The stories are being made free to read by removing paywalls.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am building an newsletter for Short Science Fiction, using news stories of the day as inspiration. Purposely limiting the length to 3 chapters.

Currently removing the paywall from all my stories. If I have missed one, let me know.
mentions.author: yitchelle
